reason: A DSH control-plane plugin for observing and driving Herdr terminal workspaces used by AI coding agents, with session-scoped UI and workspace lifecycle management.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 会话中观察和控制 Herdr AI 编程代理终端工作区，并提供按会话隔离的标签页与侧栏界面。
summaries.en: Observe and control Herdr terminal workspaces for AI coding agents from DeepSeek Harness sessions, with session-scoped tabs and side panels.

capabilities: Observes Herdr workspace, agent, pane, layout, and notification state
Controls Herdr workspaces and terminal panes through a local Unix-domain socket
Provides session-scoped Herdr tabs and side panels in DSH
Can create Herdr-mode sessions and may start the Herdr server from PATH
